# David Packer Reports That You Can Build A Lot Of Strength With The Muscle You Already Have Before Needing More Muscle Mass

David Packer reports that you can build a lot of strength with the muscle that you already have for quite a long time before it is necessary to add more muscle mass to increase your strength. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Details

- Strength and hypertrophy are not the same thing. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- You can build a lot of strength with the muscle that you already have for quite a long time before it is absolutely necessary to add more muscle mass. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- He never dedicated time to building muscle specifically to increase his strength as he was doing his calisthenics skills. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- If you are a really skinny dude with no muscle, he would consider putting down the skills and building up some muscle mass for six months to a year, then with that new muscle mass you could spend two years at least before needing to add more muscle. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Evidence

- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "well they're not i wouldn't say they're the same thing but the the thing is that you can build a lot of strength with the muscle that you already have for quite a long time before it's absolutely necessary to add more muscle mass to increase your strength"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "i never dedicated time to building muscle um specifically to increase my strength as i was doing my calisthenics skills"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "unless you're a really skinny dude with like no muscle on you then i would consider putting down the skills and stuff and like doing the basics and building up some muscle mass for you know six months to a year"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "and then you with all that new muscle mass you could spend a two years at least before um you know you need to consider adding some you know more muscle to your frame over the skills"
